mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that boosts equity market sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher during easing periods than during tightening periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 5% triggers a negative signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as higher unemployment reduces consumer spending and economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both increase, it signals a strong consumer demand environment that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in strong demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average triggers a negative signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as it indicates a slowdown in economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing, it signals a tightening monetary cycle that reduces S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above its 6-month moving average signals a strong labor market that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher during strong labor market periods than during weak labor market periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) is growing above its 12-month moving average and housing starts (HOUST) are increasing, it signals a strong economic growth environment that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in strong growth periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and an increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) both trigger a negative signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as they indicate a slowdown in economic activity and a weakening labor market.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal.
